intro: At Bali Yoga School, we have designed 100 Hours Ashtanga, Hatha & Vinyasa flow based Multi-style Yoga Teacher Training in Bali by incorporating the traditional teachings techniques. We have included yoga teachings of ancient & modern to our curriculum. This 100 Hour Yoga Teacher Training is recommended for those yoga learners who want to deepen their knowledge and self-practice.

100 hours yoga teacher training in Bali is the 1st part of our 200 hour yoga teacher training course. It’s for those who don’t want to complete the 200 hours in one time, so we give them an option to complete 200 hours in two parts, first semester and 2nd semester. After completing the 1st 100 hours you can join us any time to complete the 2nd 100 hours program to get the certification of the 200 hours yoga teacher training course.

In the first phase, we teach everything related to teaching methodology and all the theoretical information of the systems and their application in practical yoga i.e. benefits, contraindications, healthy movement, etc. Our class schedule is a blend of theory and practice of yoga which allows the yoga learners to stay energetic during the yoga classes.

arrival: The course starts on 1st of every month at 5:00 PM with the opening ceremony & orientation program, the course completes on 11th of every month. In order for you to rest properly before the opening ceremony on the 1st day of the course, the check-in to the school should be one day before the course begins. Your check-in time must be between 10 AM to 4 PM. We provide you a complimentary stay for that night. Your check-out on the last day of the course must be between 12 PM to 2 PM.

The best and most convenient way to travel for Bali is to take a flight to Ngurah Rai International Airport Denpasar Bali. Denpasar Bali airport is merely 38 kms from school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to receive you from Denpasar Bali airport.

Complimentary pick-up service from the DPS (I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport) is included in the course fee. Please provide your flight information once you book it, and we will arrange a pick-up for you.
